mapper.delete: delete b,c,e from iot_linkage_item a inner join iot_linkage_condition b on a.id=b.linkage_item_id inner join iot_linkage_action c on a.id=c.linkage_item_id inner join iot_linkage_condition_item e on e.linkage_condition_id=b.id where a.id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: select a.*, es.product_ids, group_concat(p.name), es.device_group_ids source_device_group_ids, es.name event_source_name from iot_linkage a left join iot_event_source es on a.event_source_id = es.id left join iot_product p on json_contains(es.product_ids, concat('', p.id)) where a.id=#{id} group by a.id

select a.*, es.name event_source_name, es.product_ids, es.status event_source_status, es.device_group_ids source_device_group_ids from iot_linkage a inner join iot_event_source es on a.event_source_id = es.id where a.status = 'enabled'
